title: SQL queries
targetPerformance: Write correct SQL for at least 9 of 10 schema-based prompts in 30 minutes, including joins, grouped filters, a subquery, and a window calculation.
whyItMatters: Answer business questions from a small relational shop database.

subskills.title: Select and filter
subskills.why: Choose columns and keep only relevant rows.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check selected columns, quoted text, and every boundary condition.
drills: Check inclusive price and date boundaries.

subskills.title: Sort and limit
subskills.selfCorrection: Check direction and add a unique tie-breaker before LIMIT.
drills: Break ties with the primary key.

subskills.title: Join tables
subskills.why: Combine related rows without losing or duplicating entities accidentally.
subskills.selfCorrection: Trace foreign keys; count matches and unmatched LEFT JOIN rows.

subskills.title: Group and filter aggregates
subskills.why: Summarize rows at the requested grain.
subskills.selfCorrection: Name the output grain; compare WHERE rows with HAVING groups.

subskills.title: Use subqueries
subskills.why: Express scalar comparisons and membership tests.
subskills.selfCorrection: Run the inner query alone, then trace correlation for one outer row.
drills: Compare a price with an average.

subskills.title: Rank within groups
subskills.why: Keep detail rows while assigning row numbers and tied ranks.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check partitions, tied ranks, and deterministic ROW_NUMBER ordering.

subskills.title: Calculate window totals
subskills.why: Show group and running totals beside individual rows.
subskills.selfCorrection: Verify the partition and explicitly use a ROWS frame for running totals.
drills: Repeat a category total per product.

barriers.fix: Sketch a three-row table and predict the output before executing later.
Keep only the SELECT reference open and time a ten-minute set.
Write one counterexample row, repair the query, and retry for progress.
